summary: Iter51 — All 3 enhancements verified end-to-end: (1) 2FA disable now requires password+TOTP (422 if password missing, 401 on wrong password, 200 on success); (2) MongoDB indexes — verified 18 indexes present in DB across 12 collections (resident_charges, resident_payments, expenses, users, audit_logs, notifications, report_runs, visitor_passes, maintenance_requests, complaints, service_bookings); ensure_indexes startup hook logs '18 applied'; (3) Monthly auto-scheduler — POST /api/reports/run-monthly-now validates month YYYY-MM (400 on invalid), returns {queued:true, month}, generates statements + summaries, idempotent re-run for same month produces 0 new rows (verified via _already_sent check on kind+target_id+month). GET /scheduler/status returns {total_runs, last_run_at, recent[]} with kinds in {summary,statement}. Non-admin (security role) gets 403 on both endpoints. Frontend /app/reports renders scheduler card with 'تشغيل الآن' button + 'عرض سجل الإرسال' that opens a recent-runs table (verified live: 23 rows showing month/kind/target/status/date including both summary and statement entries). FOUND 1 BUG and FIXED: TwoFactorSettingsPage.disable() was sending only token_code without password to /api/2fa/disable (would always 422). Fixed by including password in the POST body and clearing it after success. 11/11 backend pytest passed; frontend integration validated.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED — payload was missing 'password' field; would cause 422 on every disable attempt despite UI requiring password input.

action_items: Verify the 1-line frontend fix (password sent to /api/2fa/disable) by manually enabling 2FA on a test account and disabling it via UI. Backend + UI gating already verified.
critical_code_review_comments: two_factor.py disable() is now properly hardened: password verification via verify_password() runs BEFORE TOTP verification — order is correct (fail fast on bad credentials).
db_indexes.py is idempotent and safe (background=True). Logs clearly state count applied. Good operational signal.

monthly_reports_scheduler.py: idempotency key (kind, target_id, month) is solid; _mark_sent always runs even when sending fails so retries won't loop forever — TRADEOFF: a failed send won't auto-retry next day. Consider adding a TTL or 'ok=False' retry on next-day run if SMTP recovers (recommend P2 enhancement).

monthly_reports_scheduler.run_monthly_reports loops with `async for` over potentially large user/compound sets — fine for current scale but could benefit from concurrency limits + asyncio.gather batches if tenant count grows >1000.
FOUND BUG (FIXED): TwoFactorSettingsPage.disable() was missing password in payload — 1-line fix applied. Recommend adding a frontend test to prevent regression.
monthly_reports_scheduler /run-monthly-now uses BackgroundTasks (FastAPI). For long runs (>30s) this ties up worker process; for production scale consider Celery/RQ. Acceptable for current use.

rca of the issue: TwoFactorSettingsPage.disable() bug: developer added 'disablePassword' state and bound it to the input + button-disabled condition but forgot to include it in axios.post body. Backend would return 422 (missing field) for every UI-initiated disable. Fix: pass {token_code, password} + clear state on success. RCA: missing parity check between Pydantic backend model (DisableReq{token_code, password}) and frontend payload.
